### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/scenarios`, touching **26** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/qa/scenarios/README.md`, `packages/qa/scenarios/src/export/cli.ts`, `packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/cli.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**7** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/api/error-catalog.mdx`  _(via invalid_type (literal, a string literal in CardTitleSchema))_
- `content/docs/api/error-handling-server.mdx`  _(via invalid_type (literal, a string literal in CardTitleSchema))_
- `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`  _(via invalid_type (literal, a string literal in CardTitleSchema))_
- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`  _(via invalid_type (literal, a string literal in CardTitleSchema))_
- `content/docs/frontend/cli.mdx`  _(via invalid_type (literal, a string literal in CardTitleSchema))_
- `content/docs/frontend/plugin-development.mdx`  _(via CardTitle (symbol, a top-level type))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/concept.mdx`  _(via invalid_type (literal, a string literal in CardTitleSchema))_

⛔ **2** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via invalid_type (literal, a string literal in CardTitleSchema))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx`  _(via invalid_type (literal, a string literal in CardTitleSchema))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/qa/scenarios/README.md`, `packages/qa/scenarios/src/export/cli.ts`, `packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/cli.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **8** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **63** of **226** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **163** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **163**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **104** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **0** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json af3451b08bc39e7b4c163f52397cffe728b3e99d` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `53282b9373ab1d5948a1f9a584091131144c5def` — the merge of head `94fc897bbeadfe13c065148136542139079b77c5` into base `af3451b08bc39e7b4c163f52397cffe728b3e99d`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 53282b9373ab1d5948a1f9a584091131144c5def && git checkout 53282b9373ab1d5948a1f9a584091131144c5def
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin af3451b08bc39e7b4c163f52397cffe728b3e99d 94fc897bbeadfe13c065148136542139079b77c5 && git checkout -B drift-repro af3451b08bc39e7b4c163f52397cffe728b3e99d && git merge --no-ff 94fc897bbeadfe13c065148136542139079b77c5

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json af3451b08bc39e7b4c163f52397cffe728b3e99d
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs af3451b08bc39e7b4c163f52397cffe728b3e99d` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `94fc897bbeadfe13c065148136542139079b77c5`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/qa/scenarios/README.md, docs/qa/scenarios/asset_lifecycle.json, docs/qa/scenarios/crm_account_with_contacts.json, docs/qa/scenarios/invoice_with_line_items.json, docs/qa/scenarios/leave_balances.json, docs/qa/scenarios/order_to_cash.json, docs/qa/scenarios/project_with_tasks.json, docs/qa/scenarios/requisition_to_receipt.json, docs/qa/scenarios/service_desk.json, docs/qa/scenarios/travel_expense.json, packages/qa/scenarios/README.md, packages/qa/scenarios/src/export/cli.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/src/export/exporter.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/src/export/generic.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/src/export/manifest.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/src/loader.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/cli.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/orchestrate.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/src/schema.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/test/asset-lifecycle.test.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/test/export/exporter.test.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/test/export/fixture.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/test/export/screenshots.test.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/test/leave-balances.test.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/test/library.test.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/test/order-to-cash.test.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/test/refusals.test.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/test/requisition-to-receipt.test.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/test/runner/units.test.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/test/score/entry.test.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/test/score/scenario-cards.test.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/test/score/scenario-tags.test.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/test/service-desk.test.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/test/travel-expense.test.ts + packages/qa/scenarios/src/index.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/src/export/transcript.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/src/export/record.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/prompts.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/scorecard.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/src/export/screenshots.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/package.json, scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs, scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs

Reviewed read-only against `origin/main` at `d5fd948efc` (merge base `98583cd692`; the branch is 4 commits ahead, GitHub reports it mergeable). Inputs: card #30932 body and all four comments (triage 6684710957, claim 6707478135, reports 6708165916 and 6708667958), the #30349 body and the tier-rule comment 6687463653, #31121 and #31122, the PR body, the diff `origin/main...refs/review/pr-31136`, and the head's check-runs. Not the dispatch order and not the dev's or the seat's conclusions.

### ① Derived judgments

**Schema and loader (`schema.ts`, `loader.ts`).**
- `origin` is required and closed: `SCENARIO_ORIGINS = ['generic', 'customer-derived', 'held-out']`, `ScenarioOriginSchema = z.enum(...)` on the strict `ScenarioCardSchema`. A missing origin gets the located message naming all three values; a value outside the set gets Zod's enum refusal. Both pinned in `refusals.test.ts` (`a card with no origin`, `an origin outside the closed set`).
- Both directional refusals hold, in `checkCard` at path `origin`: `library === 'overlay' && origin === 'generic'` is refused (commit 697bb24b5b), and `library === 'open' && origin !== 'generic'` is refused (commit 94fc897bbe, the round-2 delta). Each has its green control (customer-derived and held-out load clean as the overlay; the generic base card loads clean as open), and `loadScenarioFile` is judged the same way as the directory loader. A refused card is not handed out (`cards` is empty).
- The overlay-vs-open test is ONE mechanism, not a second heuristic. At `origin/main` `loader.ts` had no notion of a library at all (no `overlay`, `open` or `realpath` anywhere in it; only `generic.ts` named the problem in prose). The head introduces the caller-stated `LoadOptions.library: 'open' | 'overlay'` (required), and the single resolver `libraryOf(dir, repoRoot)` (real path equal to the repository root joined with `docs/qa/scenarios` is `open`, anything else `overlay`), which both CLIs (`runner/cli.ts`, `export/cli.ts`) call. The loader itself reads only the declaration; no directory sniffing lives in the loader. `libraryOf` is pinned through a non-canonical spelling and a symlink, and the exporter CLI is pinned end to end with a `--cards` directory elsewhere (the generic crm card refused at `origin` before the export sees it). `src/index.ts` re-exports `loader.ts` wholesale, so `libraryOf` and `ScenarioLibrary` are on the package entry the tests import from.
- `title` is `CardTitleSchema = z.strictObject({ zh, en })`, each `z.string().regex(/\S/, 'must not be blank')`, both required. A legacy one-string title is refused at `title` with the message naming the new shape (`invalid_type` branch of the error map); so is a missing title. Missing `zh` or `en`, an empty `en`, a whitespace-only `zh`, and a third language (`ja`, unknown key under strict) are each pinned at their own path. There is no lenient conversion anywhere: `grep` of the head finds no string-to-object coercion, no `??` fallback and no conversion-layer entry for the old shape; `packages/qa/scenarios/README.md` states that the overlay owner migrates and the loader keeps no lenient conversion. This is the Prime Directive #12 shape for an internal contract.

**Readers of `title` (whole repo at the head).** Every reader picks a language explicitly:
- `export/exporter.ts`: the app README heading is `# ${c.title.en}` with `c.title.zh` on the line under it; the index entry is `{ en: card.title.en, zh: card.title.zh }`; `renderTranscript(transcript, card.title.en)`.
- `export/manifest.ts`: `GalleryAppSchema.title.zh` tightened from `string nullable` to `string min(1)`; the index test pins that `zh: null`, `zh: ''` and a missing `zh` are each refused.
- `runner/orchestrate.ts`: `CardRun.title` is typed `CardTitle` and carries the object whole into the run record as data; `record.ts` reads the record through `looseObject` and never reads `title`, and no committed run record exists under `docs/qa/platform-checklist/runs`, so nothing on disk is invalidated.
- `runner/prompts.ts`, `runner/scorecard.ts`, `runner/cli.ts`, `src/score/**`: contain no read of the card title at `origin/main` or at the head (checked by grep), so the prompt text, the scorecard keys and the console output are unchanged. The one `title` in `export/screenshots.ts` is the Console's not-found page titles, unrelated.
- No `${card.title}`, `String(title)` or `JSON.stringify` of the title object reaches a prompt, a CLI line or a scorecard key; the exporter test additionally asserts `[object Object]` appears in none of README.md, transcript.md, scorecard.md. Outside the package, no `loadScenarios`/`loadScenarioFile` caller exists (the two scripts naming `docs/qa/scenarios` only list it as a glob for gate coverage), and no doc or skill lists the card's `title` field other than `docs/qa/scenarios/README.md`, which is updated.

**Exporter (`generic.ts`, `exporter.ts`, `cli.ts`).**
- `GALLERY_GUARD` composes both rules: `card.origin !== 'generic'` adds an origin reason, `!isGalleryTier(card.tier)` (the `GALLERY_TIERS` predicate from `schema.ts`, starter or delivery, never control) adds a tier reason; `eligible` is exactly `reasons.length === 0`, and every failed rule is named. This is the tier rule of comment 6687463653 composed with the D1 origin rule.
- Nothing of `NO_GENERIC_MARKER`, `GenericGuard`, `GenericVerdict` or `isGeneric` remains anywhere in the repository at the head (the only `isGeneric` hit is an unrelated local in a dogfood test). The `ExportOptions` option is now `guard`, defaulting to `GALLERY_GUARD`; the CLI still offers no flag to pass another guard. `renderSummary` joins multiple reasons with ` · `, so the two-reason refusal renders.
- `index.json` carries `title.zh` and `title.en` from the card (`exporter.ts` line 305, pinned with the real crm strings in both languages).
- Tests show pass and refuse on each axis, on the recorded crm run with the DEFAULT guard: generic+starter exports (index titles pinned, README and transcript language picks pinned), generic+delivery exports; customer-derived+starter, held-out+starter, held-out+delivery, generic+control and customer-derived+control (both reasons) are each refused with an empty index, each with a control leg that exports the same run once a pass-all double is given. Over the real library the guard passes exactly the six starter cards and refuses the three control cards for their tier. The report's ablations (overlay rule, origin rule, tier rule, open-library rule) each turned the expected tests red; I did not re-run them (read-only), but the tests as written are capable of failing on each rule.

**Cards (the nine in `docs/qa/scenarios/`).** Each gains `"origin": "generic"` and a `{ zh, en }` title; nothing else in any card moves.
- Origin honesty against `provenance`: six starter cards say "written for this card from the domain alone ... no customer-derived content"; the three control cards say "Golden case ... of packages/cli/src/lint/corpus.ts; `expect` derived mechanically from its fixture". None names a customer or a held-out source, so `generic` is honest on all nine, and `library.test.ts` now pins every open card as `generic` with a CJK `zh` that differs from `en`.
- The `en` titles are byte-identical to the previous string titles, so they match the cards as before.
- The `zh` titles read as natural business Chinese and match their cards: 固定资产全生命周期 (register/领用与归还/维修/按月折旧/报废审批), 客户管理 (accounts and independently maintained contacts), 发票管理 (inline lines, summed total), 请假与假期余额 (types, yearly balances, day lines, route by days), 订单到收款 (the seven stages of the en title), 项目管理 (inline tasks; 任务数与工时 roll-ups match the card's `task_count` and `total_estimate` over `estimate_hours`), 采购申请到收货, 客服工单 (SLA 策略/超时升级/满意度调查), 差旅报销 (职级 standards, 两级审批). Punctuation is the ASCII colon and comma already used in these cards' `prompt.short.zh` text, so the titles follow the cards' existing convention rather than introducing a second one.

**Docs.** `docs/qa/scenarios/README.md` gains the `origin` table (value, where it comes from, where it lives, exported or not), names both loader directions and the CLI's directory rule, states the title shape, and replaces the stale "the exporter reads no tier" paragraph. `packages/qa/scenarios/README.md`'s loader example passes `library: 'open'` and states the overlay migration rule. The `schema.ts` tier doc no longer says the tier filter is a change of its own.

**Check-runs on `94fc897bbe` (the gate verdicts).** All completed; none in progress. Required set: `Lint & Repo Gates` success, `TypeScript Type Check` success, `Test Core` success (shards 1-7 success), `Build Core` success, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` success, `Test UI` success, `Live E2E UI` success; `Lint UI`, `Type Check UI`, `Build & E2E UI` skipped by the path filter (the diff touches nothing under `ui/`). Advisory: `Check PR Size`, `PR-body guards`, `Check Documentation Links`, `Flag docs affected by code changes`, `Dogfood Regression Gate` success; `Check Changeset` skipped (the `skip-changeset` label).

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/scenarios` is `private: true` (`packages/qa/scenarios/package.json`) and `docs/qa/scenarios` ships in no package's `files`, so nothing published moves: `skip-changeset` is the correct lane and no `.changeset` entry is owed. The PR body carries `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, which is right: the card format is a devx instrument, not a `packages/spec` protocol, and no authorable spec key changes. Inside the private package the breaking changes are real and deliberate: `LoadOptions.library` is required (17 in-package call sites updated), the card `title` shape and the new required `origin` refuse every unmigrated overlay card, and the exporter seam was renamed (`GalleryGuard`, `guard`, `GALLERY_GUARD`); only this package's own tests used the old names.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Runner `owner_id` and seed logic (#30913) untouched: no hunk names `owner_id`, `ownerId`, the seed or `personas[].record`. `runner/orchestrate.ts` changes only the `CardRun.title` type and its import. `personas[].record` is absent from the schema diff.
- No governed surface in the file list (no `docs/adr/**`, `.claude/**`, `skills/**`, `.github/workflows/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `ui/**`); head repo is `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, not a fork; 570 changed lines, well under the 3,000 ceiling.
- PR body: carries `Fixes #30932`, both declaration lines, the session-URL attribution and no model identifier. **Should-fix:** the body is stale against the tree since the round-2 commit 94fc897bbe. Its Acceptance notes still say "Not added: a refusal for a customer-derived or held-out card found in the OPEN library", and the What-changes bullet, the Tests bullet and the 维护者速读 risk line name only the overlay direction, while the tree refuses both directions and `refusals.test.ts` pins the open-library one. The tree is the correct one; the body's account must be brought to it (one bullet in What changes, one line in Tests, the Acceptance note replaced, the 速读 risk line naming both refusals) so the maintainer's 速读 does not understate what the loader now refuses. Not a tree defect, so not a must-fix.
- The next readers (#31121 `gallery-refresh`, #31122 `export-gallery --check`) get what they will read: a `GALLERY_GUARD` that passes generic starter and delivery cards, an `index.json` schema whose `title.zh` is required, and a loader that treats any `--cards` directory outside `docs/qa/scenarios` as the overlay. #31121's debut therefore has six eligible cards once a passing run record exists; the schema narrowing of `title.zh` cannot invalidate an existing gallery index, since nothing was ever exported under `NO_GENERIC_MARKER`.
- Minor, no action owed: `libraryOf` calls `realpathSync` on `--cards`, so a non-existent directory now fails with that error rather than `readdirSync`'s; same class of failure as before, one frame earlier.

### ④ Design judgment

Against the card and the rulings it implements: the explicit `origin` marker is what #30932 asked for, is the marker `generic.ts` already said it needed, and keeps `provenance` as prose for people; the D1 rule (never customer-derived) and the tier rule of 6687463653 (starter/delivery, never control) are composed in one guard that names every rule failed, which is the right shape for #31122's check and for a refusal line a maintainer reads. Making the loader take the library from its caller rather than guessing is the honest design, since the directory truly carries no marker; concentrating the directory judgement in one `libraryOf` used by both CLIs means there is one rule, pinned once, and the loader stays deterministic over its inputs. Refusing both directions (round 2) closes the leak the open-library README already forbade, and the refusal messages name the remedy (move it, or mark the origin it really has) with no tracker number in the prose. The `{ zh, en }` strict object with no lenient path, and readers that each pick a language, is exactly the contract #30349 item 4 (title zh/en in the index) needs, and the exporter test proves the object is never printed whole. The nine cards' origins are honest and their Chinese titles are faithful to the English and to the cards' content. Holds against the code it cites and the scenario it is accepted against.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：场景卡新增必填字段 `origin`，取值为 generic、customer-derived、held-out 三选一。卡片标题改成中英双语 `{zh, en}`。画廊导出守卫改读 `origin === 'generic'`，并叠加原有的档位规则：只导出 starter 和 delivery，永不导出 control。九张开放卡都补了中文标题。
- 为什么改：#30349 的 D2 裁决需要画廊能安全地自动导出。旧守卫靠一个“通用标记”字符串，现在换成卡片自己声明的出处。#31121 和 #31122 都依赖本卡。
- 风险与回滚：私有包，不发布。加载器双向拒收：私有 overlay 里的 generic 卡，和开放库里的 customer-derived 或 held-out 卡。overlay 维护者要把卡迁移到新形态，加载器不做宽松转换。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/qa/scenarios/src/export/generic.ts`（导出守卫）、`src/loader.ts`（双向拒收）、`src/schema.ts`（新字段）。

- 需要你做的：无。本 PR 不触及受管面，席位在 CI 全绿后自行落地。Fable 契约复审 PASS 6708765374，Head-sha `94fc897bbe`。

席位意见：可以落地。复审没有必须修改项；唯一一项应改（PR 正文落后于第 2 轮改动）已由席位补齐。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:devx#2` · Head-sha `94fc897bbeadfe13c065148136542139079b77c5` · 2026-11-07T15:12Z

- **Shape:** 35 files, +446/−124. The seat read this from the diff, not from the report.
  - **`schema.ts`:** a required closed `origin` and a strict `title {zh,en}`, both non-blank. The old string title is refused at `title`.
  - **`loader.ts`:** `LoadOptions.library` is declared by the caller and answered by `libraryOf` (a realpath compare, shared by both CLIs). The loader refuses in both directions at `origin`.
  - **`src/export/*`:** `GALLERY_GUARD` = `origin === 'generic'` ∧ tier ∈ {starter, delivery}. Nothing is left of `NO_GENERIC_MARKER`. `index.json` carries `title.zh` and `title.en`.
  - **Every title reader picks a language explicitly.** The nine cards are all `generic`, consistent with their provenance. The en titles are unchanged from the old strings.
  - **Both READMEs** document the fields and the overlay migration rule.
  - **The rest** is test fixtures.
- **Review:** the complete Fable contract review PASSed on this head (6708765374), with no must-fix.
  - **S1** (the PR body did not reflect the round-2 open-library refusal): the seat patched the body (what changes, tests, ablation, acceptance note and 速读). The read-back was identical.
  - Round 2 applied the seat rulings Q1 A, Q2 A and Q3 A.
- **Gates:**
  - Head checks: 35 `success`, 17 skipped, none red. `check-expected-skips`: OK, all 17 skips are in main's roster (exit 0).
  - `check-governed-merges`: not governed (exit 0). 570 changed lines, which is ≤ 3000.
  - The dev's `dispatch-gates --commands`: 54 derived, 54 run, all exit 0, on this head.
  - `git merge-tree` against main (`d5fd948efc`) is clean.
- **Out of scope:**
  - `Skills-docs:` n/a.
  - `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
